reason: A no-bid 'emergency' award is only lawful with a declaration on file. None exists in the record, so the emergency-procurement hypothesis is pruned.
Three independent records (award notice, budget ledger, council minutes) agree on $2.4M; a clerical error cannot explain agreement across independent sources.
Ethics guard: a corruption story naming a connection is never published on a single source. With fewer than two independent records the dossier refuses the connection claim.
The vendor's registered address matches the awarding official's — an independent conflict marker.
The award exceeds both the budget line and the cheapest disqualified bid — a price premium that urgency alone does not explain.
Two cheaper bids were dropped on technicalities — competition was thin in a way that favoured the connected vendor.
